  implicit none
  integer :: n, w, i, j, k, a, b
  integer :: l, t, x(100000), y
  integer :: ccw(100000,2), cw(100000,2)
  integer :: coll, rsdl
  x = 0
  ccw = 0
  cw = 0
  read(*,*) n, l, t
  j = 0
  k = 0
  do i = 1, n
    read(*,*) x(i), w
    if (w.eq.1) then
      j = j+1
      ccw(j,1) = i
      ccw(j,2) = x(i)
    else
      k = k+1
      cw(k,1) = i
      cw(k,2) = x(i)
    end if
  end do
  a = j
  b = k
  if (a.eq.0) then
    t = mod(t,l)
    do i = 1, n
      write(*,'(i0)') mod(x(i)+(l-t),l)
    end do
    stop
  end if
  if (b.eq.0) then
    t = mod(t,l)
    do i = 1, n
      write(*,'(i0)') mod(x(i)+t,l)
    end do
    stop
  end if
  !反時計の蟻の静止系に変換
  !速さを半分にする代わりに時間を倍にする
  t = 2*t
  do j = 1, a
    ccw(j,2) = ccw(j,2)-cw(1,2)
    if (ccw(j,2).lt.0) ccw(j,2) = ccw(j,2)+l
  end do
  call merge_sort(ccw(1:a,:),2)
  ccw(a+1,2) = l
  rsdl = mod(t,l)
  j = 0
  do while ((j.le.a).and.(rsdl.lt.ccw(j+1,2)))
    j = j+1
  end do
  coll = (t/l)*a+j
  do j = 1, a
    ccw(j,2) = x(ccw(j,1))
  end do
  i = cw(1,1)
  cw(1:b,2) = mod(cw(1:b,2)+rsdl,l)
  cw(b+1:n,:) = ccw(1:a,:)
  call merge_sort(cw(1:n,:),2)
  do k = 1, n
    if (cw(k,1).eq.i) then
      j = k
      exit
    end if
  end do
  do k = j, n
    cw(k,1) = i+coll+k-j
    if (cw(k,1).gt.n) cw(k,1) = cw(k,1)-n
  end do

  end do

  t = mod(t/2,l)

  end do

  end do

subroutine merge_sort(a,j)
    implicit none
    integer, intent(inout) :: a(:,:)
    integer, intent(in) :: j
    integer :: n, m, l, i, u
    n = size(a(:,1))
    m = n
    l = 1
    do while (m.gt.1)
      do i = 1, m/2
        u = min(2*i*l,n)
        call merger(a(2*(i-1)*l+1:(2*i-1)*l,:),a((2*i-1)*l+1:u,:),j)
      end do
      l = 2*l
      m = (m+1)/2
    end do
    return
  end subroutine merge_sort
  subroutine merger(a1,a2,j)
    implicit none
    integer, intent(inout) :: a1(:,:), a2(:,:)
    integer, intent(in) :: j
    integer :: a(size(a1(:,1))+size(a2(:,1)),size(a1(1,:)))
    integer :: i1, i2, n1, n2
    i1 = 1
    i2 = 1
    n1 = size(a1(:,1))
    n2 = size(a2(:,1))
    do while (i1.le.n1.and.i2.le.n2)
      if (a1(i1,j).le.a2(i2,j)) then
        a(i1+i2-1,:) = a1(i1,:)
        i1 = i1+1
      else
        a(i1+i2-1,:) = a2(i2,:)
        i2 = i2+1
       end if
    end do
    if (i1.le.n1) then
      a(i1+i2-1:n1+n2,:) = a1(i1:n1,:)
    else if (i2.le.n2) then
      a(i1+i2-1:n1+n2,:) = a2(i2:n2,:)
    end if
    a1 = a(1:n1,:)
    a2 = a(n1+1:n1+n2,:)
    return
  end subroutine merger
end program ants_on_a_circle

  xws <- map (map read . words) <$> replicateM n getLine :: IO [[Int]]
  mapM_ print $ solve n l t xws

  | d >= 0 = drop (n-d) ps ++ take (n-d) ps
  | d < 0 = drop (-d)  ps ++ take (-d)  ps
  where

(defun main ()

         (l (read))
         (time (read))
         (inits (make-array n :element-type 'uint32))
         (dirs (make-array n :element-type 'bit)))
    (dotimes (i n) (setf (aref inits i) (read-fixnum)
                         (aref dirs i) (rem (read-fixnum) 2)))
    (let* ((count0 (loop for i below n
                         unless (= (aref dirs 0) (aref dirs i))
                         sum (count-collision (aref inits 0) (aref inits i) l time)))
           (end-index (mod (if (zerop (aref dirs 0))
                               (- count0)
                               count0)
                           n))
           (ends (make-array n :element-type 'uint32))
           (end0 (mod (+ (aref inits 0)
                         (if (zerop (aref dirs 0))
                             (- time)
                             time))
                      l)))
      (dotimes (i n)
        (setf (aref ends i)
              (mod (+ (aref inits i)
                      (if (zerop (aref dirs i))
                          (- time)
                          time))
                   l)))
      (setf ends (sort ends #'<))
      (let ((actual-index (- (position end0 ends) end-index))
            (res (make-array n :element-type 'uint32)))
        (when (= (aref ends actual-index) (aref ends (mod (+ actual-index 1) n)))
          (when (= 1 (aref dirs 0))
            (setf actual-index (mod (+ actual-index 1) n))))
        (when (= (aref ends actual-index) (aref ends (mod (- actual-index 1) n)))
          (when (= 0 (aref dirs 0))
            (setf actual-index (mod (- actual-index 1) n))))
        (loop for i below n
              do (setf (aref res i)
                       (aref ends (mod (+ actual-index i) n))))
        (map () #'println res)))))

def f(circle, ants, limit)
  g = lambda{|a, b|
    return Float::INFINITY if a[:dir] == b[:dir]

    if a[:dir] == :r
      ((b[:coord]-a[:coord])%circle).fdiv(2)
    else
      (circle-((b[:coord]-a[:coord])%circle)).fdiv(2)
    end
  }

  dirs = ants.map{|v| v[:dir]}
  # 全て同じ方向
  if dirs.all?{|v| v == dirs.first }
    return ants.map{|v| (v[:coord] + limit) % circle }
  end

  time = 0
  while time < limit
    # p ants
    steps = ants.size.times.map{|i|
      #p [i, (i+i)%ants.size]
      g.(ants[i], ants[(i+1)%ants.size])
    }
    step = steps.min
    step = limit - time if time + step > limit
    
    time += step
    ants.each_with_index{|v, i|
      v[:coord] = (v[:coord] + step * (v[:dir] == :r ? 1 : -1)) % circle
      if steps[i] == step || steps[(i-1)%ants.size] == step
        v[:dir] = (v[:dir] == :r ? :l : :r)
      end
    }
  end
  ants.map{|v| v[:coord].to_i}
end

def solve_it_large(n, l, t, x, w):
    ants = []
    for i in range(n):
        ants.append([x[i], w[i], (x[i] + w[i] * t) % l, i])
    # ants.sort()

    n_intersections = 0
    x0, w0, dest0, i0 = ants[0]
    for x, w, dest, i in ants:
        if w != w0:
            d = (w0 * (x - x0) + l) % l
            intersections = 0
            if 2 * t >= d:
                intersections = (2 * t - d) // l + 1
            n_intersections += intersections

    res = [0] * n
    shift = n_intersections
    for i in range(n):
        res[ants[(i + w0 * shift) % n][3]] = ants[i][2]
    return res


def solve_it_chameleons(n, l, t, x, w):
    initial_color = [i for i in range(n)]

    chameleons = [[x[i], w[i], initial_color[i]] for i in range(n)]
    initial_color_clockwise = [chameleons[i][2] for i in range(n)]

    x0, w0, color0 = chameleons[0]
    for i in range(n):
        if w[i] != w0:
            d = (w0 * (x[i] - x0)) % l
            meet = 0
            if 2 * t >= d:
                meet = (2 * t - d) // l + 1
            color0 += w0 * meet
            color0 %= n

    # The chameleon (let's call him chameleon 0) initially at x0 is at (x0 + w0 * t) % l at the end,
    # Initially, its color is color0 and it changed <meet> times.
    # The final clockwise colors are a translation of the initial clockwise colors.

    x_final = [(x[i] + w[i] * t) % l for i in range(n)]
    x_final.sort()
    i = x_final.index((x0 + w0 * t) % l)
    if i + 1 < n and x_final[i] == x_final[i + 1]:
        if w0 == 1:
            i += 1
    res = [0] * n
    for k in range(n):
        color = (color0 + k) % n
        res[color] = x_final[(i+k) % n]
    return res

def solve_it_large(n, l, t, x, w):
    ants = []
    for i in range(n):
        ants.append([x[i], w[i], (x[i] + w[i] * t) % l, i])
    # ants.sort()

    n_intersections = 0
    x0, w0, dest0, i0 = ants[0]
    for x, w, dest, i in ants:
        if w != w0:
            d = (w0 * (x - x0) + l) % l
            intersections = 0
            if 2 * t >= d:
                intersections = (2 * t - d) // l + 1
            n_intersections += intersections

    res = [0] * n
    shift = n_intersections
    for i in range(n):
        res[ants[(i + w0 * shift) % n][3]] = ants[i][2]
    return res


def solve_it_chameleons(n, l, t, x, w):
    initial_color = [i for i in range(n)]

    chameleons = [[x[i], w[i], initial_color[i]] for i in range(n)]
    initial_color_clockwise = [chameleons[i][2] for i in range(n)]

    x0, w0, color0 = chameleons[0]
    for i in range(n):
        if w[i] != w0:
            d = (w0 * (x[i] - x0)) % l
            meet = 0
            if 2 * t >= d:
                meet = (2 * t - d) // l + 1
            color0 += w0 * meet
            color0 %= n

    # The chameleon (let's call him chameleon 0) initially at x0 is at (x0 + w0 * t) % l at the end,
    # Initially, its color is color0 and it changed <meet> times.
    # The final clockwise colors are a translation of the initial clockwise colors.

    x_final = [(x[i] + w[i] * t) % l for i in range(n)]
    x_final.sort()
    i = x_final.index((x0 + w0 * t) % l)
    if i + 1 < n and x_final[i] == x_final[i + 1]:
        if w0 == 1:
            i += 1
    res = [0] * n
    for k in range(n):
        color = (color0 + k) % n
        res[color] = x_final[(i+k) % n]
    return res

import sys


def solve_it_chameleons(n, l, t, x, w):
    initial_color = [i for i in range(n)]

    chameleons = [[x[i], w[i], initial_color[i]] for i in range(n)]
    initial_color_clockwise = [chameleons[i][2] for i in range(n)]

    x0, w0, color0 = chameleons[0]
    for i in range(n):
        if w[i] != w0:
            d = (w0 * (x[i] - x0)) % l
            meet = 0
            if 2 * t >= d:
                meet = (2 * t - d) // l + 1
            color0 += w0 * meet
            color0 %= n

    # The chameleon (let's call him chameleon 0) initially at x0 is at (x0 + w0 * t) % l at the end,
    # Initially, its color is color0 and it changed <meet> times.
    # The final clockwise colors are a translation of the initial clockwise colors.

    x_final = [(x[i] + w[i] * t) % l for i in range(n)]
    x_final.sort()

    # In the special case where chameleon meets just at the end, they swap their colors.
    # The index need to be incremented if he walks clockwise.
    i = x_final.index((x0 + w0 * t) % l)
    if i + 1 < n and x_final[i] == x_final[i + 1]:
        if w0 == 1:
            i += 1
    res = [0] * n
    for k in range(n):
        color = (color0 + k) % n
        res[color] = x_final[(i+k) % n]
    return res

if first_ant[1] == 1: #一番の子が1向きの場合

    last_pos_of_first_ant = (first_ant[0] + T ) % L
    num_of_reverse_ant = [item[1] for item in pos_list].count(2)

    cnt = 0
    reverse_ant_pos = [item[0] for item in pos_list if item[1] == 2]
    cnt += T//L * len(reverse_ant_pos)

    for i in reverse_ant_pos:
        if (i - first_ant[0])//2 +1 <= (T % L):
            cnt += 1
    
    last_num_of_first_ant = (1 + cnt) % N
    if last_num_of_first_ant == 0:
        last_num_of_first_ant += N

else:
    last_pos_of_first_ant = (first_ant[0] - T ) % L
    num_of_reverse_ant = [item[1] for item in pos_list].count(1)

    cnt = 0
    reverse_ant_pos = [item[0] for item in pos_list if item[1] == 1]

    cnt += T//L * len(reverse_ant_pos)

    for i in reverse_ant_pos:
        if ((first_ant[0] -(i-L))//2 + 1) <= (T % L):
            cnt += 1
            # print(T % L)
            # print(i, first_ant[0] -(i-L),(first_ant[0] -(i-L))//2 + 1) 
            # print('cnt', cnt)
    
    last_num_of_first_ant = (1 - cnt) % N
    if last_num_of_first_ant <= 0:
        last_num_of_first_ant += N

# アリの位置を求める
last_ant_pos = []

for ant_pos, direction  in pos_list:
    if direction == 1:
        last_ant_pos.append((ant_pos + T)%L)
    else:
        ant_pos = (ant_pos - T)%L
        if ant_pos < 0:

# first ant さんは位置Xにいるので、アリの位置リストからどれがfirst antさんか特定する。

            temp_num = (last_num_of_first_ant+i)%N

            res.append([pos, temp_num])

    res.sort(key=lambda x:x[1])
else:

        temp_num = (last_num_of_first_ant-i)%N
        if temp_num == 0:
            temp_num = N
        res.append([pos, temp_num])

    res.sort(key=lambda x:x[1], reverse=True)

def main():
    n, l, t = map(int, input().split())
    xs, ds = [], []
    for _ in range(n):
        x, w = [int(c) for c in input().split()]
        xs.append(x)
        ds.append(1 if w == 1 else -1)

    xs_thr = [(x + d * t) % l for x, d in zip(xs, ds)]
    xs_thr_sorted = [(x, i) for i, x in enumerate(xs_thr)]
    xs_thr_sorted.sort()
    i2p = {i: p for p, (x, i) in enumerate(xs_thr_sorted)}

    x_groups = {
        -1: [x for i, x in enumerate(xs) if ds[i] == -1],
        1: [x for i, x in enumerate(xs) if ds[i] == 1],
    }

    def bin_count(arr, v):
        if len(arr) == 0 or v <= arr[0]:
            return 0
        p, q = 0, len(arr)
        while q - p > 1:
            m = (p + q) // 2
            if arr[m] < v:
                p = m
            else:
                q = m
        return q

    def collide(i):
        pos = xs[i] + t * ds[i] * 2
        itera = len(x_groups[-ds[i]]) * abs(pos // l)
        f_delta = bin_count(x_groups[-ds[i]], xs[i])
        b_delta = bin_count(x_groups[-ds[i]], pos % l)
        return itera + (b_delta - f_delta) * ds[i]

    for i in range(n):
        p = i2p[i]
        print(xs_thr_sorted[(p - collide(i) * ds[i] % n + n) % n][0])

https://atcoder.jp/contests/agc013/tasks/agc013_c

蟻がカードを持っていて、すれ違う際にカードを交換すると考える
T秒後にどの蟻がどのカードを持っているか考えればいい

Tが大きいため、良い感じに処理する必要がある
→1周をシミュレートする？
→1周した際の変化を累積させ、最後の余分な時間分を計算すればいい

1週分のシミュレーションには、最悪(N/2)**2 = 2500000000
がかかるので、もっと高速化を考える必要がある

実は1周するにあたり、カードは以下のように動く
>>>> <<<<
7531 2468

>> <<<<
31 24
75   68

つまり、2回かけて1つ後ろに移動する

あとは計算しやすいような工夫を考える
普通に移動経路を時間とともに列挙しようとするとO(LCM(右向き,左向き))かかる

時計回りのやつは+1される。反時計回りのやつは-1される

X = []

for n in range(N):
    x, w = map(int, input().split())
    X.append(x)
    if w == 1:
        W.append(1)
    else:
        W.append(-1)

if DEBUG:
    print('アリの数', N)
    print('長さ', L)
    print('時間', T)
    print('位置', X)
    print('向き', W)

# 0番目のアリがT秒後にどこにいるか
x = (X[0] + W[0] * T) % L
if x < 0:
    x += L

# T秒後のすれ違い回数
cross_num = 0
for i in range(1, N):
    # direction
    if W[0] != W[i]:
        x_diff = X[0] - X[i]
        if x_diff < 0:
            x_diff += L

        # 少なくとも1回はすれ違う
        if x_diff / 2 <= T:
            cross_num += 1

            # あと何回すれ違うか
            rest = T - x_diff / 2
            num = rest // T
            cross_num += num
